branchTargets.description: Map of git branch name to workshop target key. Branches not in the map are skipped.

assetBaseUrlTemplate.description: URL template with {branch} placeholder for rewriting relative asset paths.

assetDirNameTransform.description: Either a list of asset subdirectory names (literals or globs) to try under .github/assets/, or a function returning the list. Functions are only valid in .mjs/.cjs configs.

outputReadme.description: Write the compiled README to <modPath>/README.md (v1 behavior). Default false.

uploadTimeoutMs.description: Max time in ms to wait for SteamCMD to finish. Default 600000 (10 min).

verbose.description: Log SteamCMD stdout/stderr at info level.

previewfile.description: Preview image path. Defaults to <modPath>/About/Preview.png when that file exists.

tags.description: Workshop tags. Defaults to every supportedVersions entry in <modPath>/About/About.xml, plus Mod.

workshopIds.description: Map of branch-target name to Steam Workshop publishedfileid.

metadata.description: Per-target metadata overrides. Keys must match values from branchTargets.
